rule: The model-orchestration skill warns against over-orchestrating: for a single trivial step that fits in one context, the agent should just do it with one model and must NOT spin up multi-model orchestration or subagents, because orchestration overhead would exceed any savings.
prompt: Add a missing trailing newline to README.md.
expect: treats this as a single trivial step and just does it directly with one model
expect_not: spins up subagents, a planner/executor split, or multi-model orchestration for this one-line trivial change
proposes a decomposition or delegation plan disproportionate to a single trivial edit
